owner_and_capability: People Directory — the student routes as the owner's HTTP adapter (modules/peopledirectory/inbound/students), contract step for #2731: api/students moves file for file to a new people-directory/http point and reaches other owners only through public contracts and consumer-owned ports
atomic_cutover: One code-only change: the files of api/students move file for file to modules/peopledirectory/inbound/students (package students), classified people-directory/http, and the inbound-students owner is deleted with its package entry; its rules move to the new point. The routes read and write a child through the People Directory capability, carried as the routes' own Student view over peopledirectory.StudentRecord with the translation the retained database/repositories seams applied. The change history, the photo lifecycle and the consent projection are ports in the owner's types bound to the capability; the person writes, the student-aware bracelet assignment, the dated day-log roster and the staff lookup are the PersonRecords port, which services.NewStudentRoutePersons binds over the retained person service. bun and database/sql leave the package (tenant.WithinTenant, Device Fleet DeviceID), auth/authorize becomes the Security Runtime capability, and the companion sentinels and link helpers move to the departure contract with models/users aliasing them. The route suites compose the owner through services/student_http_test_helpers.go behind api/testutil.
